preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10,000.
The number of vertices in each tree is between 2 and 200,000.
The vertices of each edge are within the range of the number of vertices.

preconditions.expression: The sum of N over all test cases won't exceed 2 * 10^5
preconditions.description: The total number of vertices across all test cases does not exceed 200,000.

postconditions.description: The minimum number of edges to add is non-negative.
The minimum number of edges to add is less than or equal to the number of vertices minus one.
The resulting graph G must have a Hamiltonian path.
